notes: Bounds are regression/consistency checks, not a calibrated vessel performance envelope.
Zigzag uses heading-triggered discrete rudder reversals, no heading-hold controller.
Coast stopping: horizontal speed <0.1 m/s for 1 s. Reverse-braking: first nonpositive surge, with remaining sway explicitly reported; not necessarily zero ground speed.

Version 3 quality targets declared before final preflight runs: zigzag overshoot <25 deg, zero-rudder recovery excursion <30 deg and settling <20 s, continuous astern yaw <0.5 deg/s. Engineering screening targets, not measured vessel limits or IMO certification; failures stay failures.
servo_rate_source: Actual joint velocity limit and reference trajectory rate read separately from each generated boat.sdf; numerical tolerance 1e-6 rad/s
